items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: we were playing for a general whose name was Chesty Puller... I heard him say “that’s my kind of Marine.”

ctx.x: You had to play for marches and assemblies and all that kind of thing?

All those things. And for instance one thing I remember very well, we were playing for a general whose name was Chesty Puller. He was one of the most famous of the Marine generals. And he was giving a medal of honor I think to some Marine who had earned that, and we played for that ceremony, and I remember that. And there were certain procedures you go through when you go up and salute the general and he throws the salute back and when I executed all these things that I was supposed to do and I heard him say…
Nice. Did you play dance music also for the base?
